topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: Well, isn't this the most curious twist? Unearthed from the depths of the garden, a time capsule, its metal gleaming under the afternoon sun, as if it's been there and not there all along. I trace the engravings, each lineprick so familiar, yet utterly foreign. How peculiar, how wonderfully so, to find this chest of yesteryear, filled with newspapers, old coins, and a faded photograph that must belong to someone, perhaps even me from another breeze, another shadow. It’s all a delightful mystery, and I can't help but chuckle, thinking of the stories it holds, waiting to spill out like sunshine. The world, it seems, is full of such lovely surprises and hidden treasures, just waiting to be discovered.
